name: Ahaziah
summary: The youngest son of Jehoram king of Judah, who reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother Athaliah counselled him to follow Ahab's house, and Jehu struck him down when he went to visit King Joram.

key_moments.title: Follows the Ways of Ahab's House
key_moments.description: Ahaziah became king in Jerusalem after his father Jehoram. His mother Athaliah was Omri's daughter, and with her and Ahab's house as his counsellors, he did evil like the house of Ahab.

key_moments.title: Fights Syria Beside Joram
key_moments.description: Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab, king of Israel, to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead. When Joram was wounded, Ahaziah went down to Jezreel to see him.

key_moments.title: Struck Down Fleeing from Jehu
key_moments.description: Ahaziah rode out with Joram to meet Jehu. When Jehu shot Joram, Ahaziah fled, and Jehu's men struck him in his chariot near Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo and died there, and was buried in Jerusalem.
